title: Haibane Renmei
author: ASheby
reason: A quiet, melancholic masterpiece about belonging and redemption that nobody talks about

title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu
author: ASheby
reason: A stunning period drama about a dying art form with some of the best character writing in anime

title: Tatami Galaxy
author: ASheby
reason: Witty, fast-paced and visually creative — a love letter to wasted youth

title: Kaiba
author: ASheby
reason: Surreal sci-fi about memory and identity with a gorgeous unique art style almost no one has seen

title: Ergo Proxy
author: ASheby
reason: A dark cyberpunk mystery packed with philosophy and psychological themes that many viewers skipped because of its complex storytelling

title: Bakemonogatari
author: ASheby
reason: Underrated because of its heavy dialogue and unique storytelling style, which makes it less accessible, but it has exceptional writing, direction, and character development.
